about: OData requests that BI and spreadsheet products send, one per entry, driven by odata-consumer-shapes.test.ts against a synthetic file ('Shop', entity set Items: Name 'Item 01'..'Item 25', Qty 1..25). 'verified' is true only where the cited page states the request. No product's private behaviour is guessed.

cases.note: The sample writes $top, $skip, $select and $orderby ("col asc|desc" joined with ", ") into the query string, and its query-string builder encodes the $ as %24.
A row count is the /$count path segment, a scalar read as text (Accept: text/plain).
The page says /$count errors when $top or $skip ride along, so the sample falls back to counting locally. The answer here is either the count or a clean 400, never a 5xx.
The page states OData V4 is read as JSON feeds, the metadata document as XML, and the login is a user name and password. It names no query options (the connector extracts).

cases.source: OData Version 4.0 Part 1: Protocol, section 11.2.5.5 (System Query Option $count)
OData Version 4.0 Part 1: Protocol, section 8.2.8.6 (Prefer odata.maxpagesize)
OData Version 4.0 Part 1: Protocol, sections 11.2.4.1 ($select) and 11.2.5.7 (server-driven paging)
OData Version 4.0 Part 2: URL Conventions, sections 5.1.1.4 and 5.1.1.5 (built-in filter operators and functions)

request.path: /Shop/Items?%24filter=contains(tolower(Name)%2C'item 1') and Qty ge 10 and Qty lt 14&%24orderby=Qty

notVerified: Power BI / Excel / Power Query OData.Feed: the connector's own requests ($metadata handling, which $filter functions it folds, Prefer headers, $batch) are not described on any Microsoft page found; the existing odata-clients.test.ts keeps the request shapes seen in practice, which are not cited.
Tableau: the page lists no query options, $batch, $apply or paging behaviour; only V4 JSON, XML metadata, user name and password, and that it extracts.
Looker Studio, Zapier and Make: no first-party OData documentation was found, so no request is asserted for them.
OAuth sign-in: the OData endpoint accepts Basic, a Data API session token or an API token as Bearer; there is no OAuth authorisation flow for an OData client to follow.
